2608.25428.title: DCGC: Draft-Conditioned Global Correction for Complex Reasoning with Masked Diffusion Models
2608.25428.paper_summary: Correcting flawed reasoning traces remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), whose autoregressive generation can propagate early mistakes into subsequent reasoning. We introduce DCGC, a Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) framework for global correction that uses an imperfect solution draft from an upstream solver as auxiliary context. DCGC combines task-specific Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with a novel inference-time mechanism called Dynamic Dual-CFG. This mechanism separates problem-only and joint problem-draft branches and scales the draft-conditioned residual using a relative confidence gap. Across math, code, and knowledge reasoning benchmarks, DCGC outperforms standard sampling and simpler CFG variants, with additional results suggesting transfer to different diffusion backbones. In test-time setting where ground-truth failure labels are unavailable, DCGC improves full test set accuracy by correcting low-consensus upstream outputs, highlighting its utility as a verifier-free global correction module for difficult reasoning instances.
2608.25428.paper_summary_zh: 修正有缺陷的推理痕跡對大型語言模型（LLMs）來說仍然是一個重大挑戰，因為它們的自回歸生成可能將早期的錯誤傳播到後續的推理中。我們介紹了DCGC，一種用於全局修正的遮罩擴散模型（MDM）框架，它使用來自上游求解器的不完美解決草稿作為輔助上下文。DCGC將特定任務的監督微調（SFT）與一種名為動態雙CFG的新推理時間機制結合起來。這種機制將僅問題和聯合問題-草稿分支分開，並使用相對置信差距來縮放草稿條件的殘差。在數學、代碼和知識推理基準測試中，DCGC的表現超過了標準抽樣和更簡單的CFG變體，額外的結果表明可以轉移到不同的擴散骨幹。在測試時間設置中，當無法獲得真實的失敗標籤時，DCGC通過修正低共識的上游輸出來提高整個測試集的準確性，突顯了它作為一個無驗證者的全局修正模塊在困難推理實例中的實用性。
